# Contributing to Elephant

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Elephant!

The full contributor guide is part of the documentation:
**https://elephant.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contribute.html**

## Before you start

**Open an issue first.** Every pull request must be linked to an
[issue](https://github.com/NeuralEnsemble/elephant/issues) that a maintainer
has agreed to. Please wait for this agreement before you open a pull request.
Only trivial changes (typos, broken links, small docstring fixes) are exempt
from this rule.
